column1: # The abstract methods that org.mongodb:bson, mongodb-driver-core, mongodb-driver-sync and mongodb-driver-legacy 5.15.0
# add to the public interfaces and abstract classes of org.mongodb:mongo-java-driver 3.12.14, which a class that
# implements one of them has to implement to compile against driver 5. Each is listed under every type that has it,
# declared or inherited, and declared in terms of that type's own type variables, with the parameter names of the
# driver's sources. A declaration that names a type of the driver's internal API is marked internal.
# type, type variables, method, erased parameter types, internal, declaration
